script_text: Halt, Aries! The cosmos is issuing a direct command to your fiery soul. Mars, your ruling planet, is transiting the 12th House of the Subconscious in intuitive Pisces, forming a precise sextile to Uranus in your 2nd House of Finances. This dynamic aspect sparks sudden insights about resources and self-worth, urging innovative financial strategies. In love, Venus's trine to Neptune in your 7th House of Partnerships fosters deep empathy—committed Aries, share vulnerabilities to strengthen bonds; if single, you're attracting artistic, compassionate souls. Career-wise, the Sun in your 1st House of Identity squares Pluto in your 10th House of Ambition, warning against power struggles that could impact income. Blessing: An unexpected mentor offers guidance for prosperity. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate the celestial tides.
